module.Title: Foundation Challenge
module.Teaching: Combine several variable types to describe the player with health, resources, a name, and equipment.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which variable stores a yes-or-no state?
module.PredictionExplanation: hasPickaxe uses bool, which stores true or false.
module.DebugPrompt: Repair the missing semicolon and the incorrect types or quotation marks.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild all four player variables from memory. Use these exact identifiers: Miner, hasPickaxe, playerHealth, playerName, stoneCount. Use these exact values: 0, 100, "Miner", true.
module.TransferPrompt: Create enemyHealth, enemyName, and enemyActive. Use the exact identifier Slime. Use these exact values: 30, "Slime", true.
module.PreviewMessage: The complete foundation state is ready.
